description: Replace the HTML behind an existing page. The URL and access settings stay; new local images and videos are uploaded and ones the page no longer uses are deleted.

expires.description: Also set the expiry: 30m, 12h, 7d, 2w, a date, or "never".

html.description: The page as an HTML string (up to 5 MB), instead of `path`. Cannot carry local images or videos.

path.description: Path to the .html or .htm file (absolute, or relative to where the server runs). Its local images and videos are uploaded too.

slug.description: The page slug (the last part of its URL).

name: update_page
title: Update a page
